name: Migdol
brief: A place near the Red Sea where the Israelites camped
short: Migdol, a place near the Red Sea where the Israelites camped during the Exodus (<ref="Exodus 14:2; Numbers 33:7">Exodus 14:2; Numbers 33:7</ref>), and a city in Egypt mentioned in prophecies (<ref="Jeremiah 44:1; 46:14; Ezk.29.10; 30:6">Jeremiah 44:1; 46:14; Ezk.29.10; 30:6</ref>).
